title: OSynth: A Longitudinal, Context-Sensitive Evaluation of Meeting Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.29319v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Meeting notetakers are increasingly deployed in settings where longitudinal context is available including calendar metadata, prior meetings, emails, slides, and speaker enrollments; however, meeting corpora remain limited in terms of size, domain coverage, and available context. We present OSynth, a large-scale synthetic dataset of simulated organizations comprising 570 hours of meeting audio together with associated artifacts and a latent ground-truth state. In a pairwise comparison, human raters distinguish OSynth meetings from real meeting transcripts with only 56% accuracy based on excerpts of 150-300 words. Across state-of-the-art LLMs, additional context yields significant gains on several entity-sensitive dimensions, demonstrating limitations of contemporary approaches and the potential usefulness of OSynth in developing better-contextualized meeting-understanding systems.

translated_title: OSynth：面向会议理解的纵向、上下文敏感评估
translated_abstract: 会议记录工具正越来越多地部署在具有纵向上下文信息的环境中，这些信息包括日历元数据、以往会议、电子邮件、幻灯片和说话人注册信息；然而，现有会议语料库在规模、领域覆盖范围和可用上下文方面仍然有限。我们提出了OSynth，这是一个大规模的模拟组织合成数据集，包含570小时的会议音频以及相关产物和潜在的真实状态。在成对比较实验中，人类评估者基于150-300词的摘录，仅能以56%的准确率区分OSynth会议与真实会议记录。在多个最先进的大语言模型上，额外的上下文信息在多个实体敏感维度上带来了显著提升，这展示了现有方法的局限性，以及OSynth在开发更好上下文化的会议理解系统方面的潜在价值。
tldr: OSynth是一个包含570小时模拟组织会议音频的大规模合成数据集，其真实感使人类难以与真实会议区分，并证明额外的上下文信息能显著提升大语言模型在实体敏感会议理解任务上的表现。
en_tdlr: OSynth is a large-scale synthetic dataset of 570 hours of simulated organizational meeting audio that human raters can barely distinguish from real meetings, demonstrating that additional context significantly improves state-of-the-art LLMs on entity-sensitive meeting understanding tasks.
